ruling: R39 (Drew, 2026-09-15): baseball pool rows on `topps-allen-ginter` whose stated rung belongs to `topps-chrome`'s checklist ladder and NOT to `topps-allen-ginter`'s are re-keyed to `topps-chrome`.
reportOnlyUntil: REPORT ONLY until a steward dispatches it. This file routes nothing by existing; the lane writes only under BACKFILL_APPLY=true. Dispatch SCOPE=data/pool-relocations/<this file>, one part at a time.
finding: 983 rows name a rung that is checklist-backed under `topps-chrome` and checklist-backed NOWHERE under `topps-allen-ginter`. The 2026-09-15 parallel-gap measurement found these rows reading as "no checklist row at that parallel" when the ladder exists — under the sibling product.
rulings: THE MEMBERSHIP TEST IS BOTH-SIDED. A row moves only when its rung is checklist-backed in the DESTINATION and checklist-backed nowhere in the SOURCE. A rung in BOTH ladders is ambiguous and is left alone; a rung in NEITHER is an acquisition, not a re-key. Counts for both exclusions are in `leftAlone` below.
BASE IS NEVER MOVED. A row whose rung is empty or `Base` states no parallel, so it carries no evidence about which product it belongs to.

TWO SHAPES, BECAUSE cardId IS NOT ALWAYS A SLUG. sold_comps partitions on /cardId, but for vendor rows that is an opaque id and the setKey lives only in hobbyiqCardId: slug cardId -> RELOCATE (real partition move), opaque cardId -> REPOINT (hobbyiqCardId patched in place, #1941 address guard still runs).
SPLIT-IDENTITY ROWS ARE EXCLUDED. Where cardId disagrees with hobbyiqCardId on sport or year, the row is left for the split-identity lane rather than swept along.

census.note: every count read from prod read-only on 2026-09-15, paged by (sport, year, setKey) slug prefix; no cross-partition COUNT was issued over sold_comps.
